release_notes: Tachyon AIO v0.45.36 completes the v0.45.35 hotfix with a final runtime authority for every updater surface. The seven-tab navigation remains stabilized without the continuous DOM MutationObserver/reordering loop that made tabs unresponsive in v0.45.34. The Update Available dialog and the later byte-backed download/progress UI are now forced to black, graphite, gray, and white, with legacy cyan, blue, purple, neon glow, and source-order overrides explicitly neutralized. Regression coverage rejects those legacy updater accent colors from the final authority. No task execution, checkout, cookie/session, retailer, or purchase behavior was changed.
